runtimeDescription: Current main rag-build-store.ts and production shared dist/onboarding sources in existing haive-worker; round-2 branch rag-eval.ts, fixture identity helper, metrics, report and dense check copied into /tmp/rge-s-codex-2/runtime/scripts. No app source edited or rebuilt in the container. Production source/dist hashes match the pinned protocol and round-1 runtime.

scratch.lifecycle: Dry-run first; fresh store built and measured hybrid + lexical + verified forced-HNSW-vs-exact. Post-measurement metadata SELECT corrected from haive_embeddings to ai_rag_embeddings; then dropped, pg_database verification 0. No live store or service changed.

limitations: Scoped shared production TypeScript only: no KB/global merge, other languages, client corpus, or real private queries.
24 answerable topics, translated and rephrased; query-bootstrap CIs are descriptive, not independent-topic population intervals.
Overview measures author-judged source-fact coverage, not generated-answer quality.
The production planner chooses exact search for all 180 queries on this small store; the forced HNSW comparison is verified separately.
Ranking knobs stayed fixed. Only the answerability diagnostic threshold uses tuning positives; it is applied unchanged to held-out.
measurementRun: RGE-S/codex-2; both arms and dense comparison from one scratch lifecycle; all committed numbers regenerated from that run.

postMeasurementFixtureHelper.note: rag-eval-fixture.ts was extended after measurement with the history-free anchor snapshot and warn-only HEAD drift helpers. The fingerprint expression sha256(manifest + newline + queries) is unchanged, now a named export (fixtureFingerprint); the committed baselines still match it. The hashes map above records the measured runtime bytes; this committed-file hash records the extended helper, not the measured file.

postMeasurementReportNote: Round 3 extends offline reports with per-cell tau FPR, Wilson intervals and paired threshold FPR/AUROC; the measured runtime report hash above is preserved. Both compact baseline files and the manifest/query fingerprint are unchanged; no new retrieval measurement.
postMeasurementSettingsNote: Round 4 restores structured settings to both compact baselines from the original codex-2 full-run settings, page keys, manifest script config, recorded runtime hashes/defaults and store width inspection (2141|0|2560|2560).
